label: Grace Hopper · 1.5 TB SSD

cpuSpecs.cache: 1 MB L2 per core · 117 MB L3 per CPU

description: Grace CPU and Hopper GPU in one tightly connected superchip, suited to supported GPU work with substantial CPU–GPU interaction.
tidbit: The name honors Grace Hopper, a pioneering computer scientist and U.S. Navy rear admiral who helped develop early compilers and influenced COBOL. NVIDIA pairs its Grace CPU with its Hopper-architecture GPU in this superchip.
goodFor: Supported CUDA AI and scientific computation, especially workloads that exchange substantial data between CPU and GPU or use a large host-side working set. The coherent NVLink-C2C connection is its distinguishing feature.
limitations: Not an x86 drop-in replacement: binaries and dependencies need ARM64 support. The 480 GB of CPU memory is not an extra 480 GB of equally fast GPU HBM. There is one GPU per node; software and access restrictions still apply.

cpu.title: Grace CPU
cpu.goodFor: Parallel Arm-compatible CPU work, data preparation, and closely coupled CPU–GPU workloads.
cpu.limitations: Running x86-only binaries unchanged. Requires ARM64-compatible dependencies; serial code will not use all 72 cores.

gpu.title: Hopper · the GPU half
gpu.text: The Hopper GPU handles supported parallel computation, including AI and scientific workloads. GH200 is the Grace Hopper superchip pairing—not a second CPU.
gpu.tidbit: Grace is the CPU name; Hopper is the GPU architecture. Together they make Grace Hopper.

memory.title: 480 GB · Grace CPU memory
memory.text: This is the CPU-side memory pool, useful for large host-side datasets and preparation work. It is separate from the GPU’s 96 GB of high-bandwidth memory.
memory.tidbit: The coherent connection supports shared access in compatible software, but CPU memory does not become equally fast GPU-local memory.

vram.title: 96 GB · Hopper GPU memory
vram.text: The GPU has its own high-bandwidth memory (HBM), designed to feed calculations quickly. Models and their working state benefit from staying close to the GPU.
vram.tidbit: HBM stands for high-bandwidth memory. Its capacity and speed are different specifications from the CPU’s 480 GB memory pool.

interconnect.title: NVLink-C2C · chip-to-chip connection
interconnect.text: A fast, coherent link between the Grace CPU and Hopper GPU. It lets supported software exchange and access data across the two processors more directly.
interconnect.tidbit: C2C means chip-to-chip. This is different from GPU-to-GPU NVLink, and it does not erase the speed differences between CPU and GPU memory.

note: Buy-in rules apply; non-owner jobs are limited to under four hours.
